approval_categories.trigger: Uncertain interpretation of legal or regulatory obligations.
New or materially changed clinical guidance or claims.
approval_categories.execution_policy: Do not publish until required review is complete.

approval_categories.trigger: New sharing, storage, AI processing, or transfer of sensitive data.
approval_categories.execution_policy: Do not activate the unapproved data flow.

approval_categories.trigger: Changes to login, authorization, identity, or patient access.
approval_categories.execution_policy: Require explicit approval and access-control testing.

approval_categories.trigger: Deployment of material changes to a production healthcare website or portal.
approval_categories.execution_policy: Require release validation and recorded approval.

approval_categories.trigger: Potential sensitive data breach or material security incident.
approval_categories.execution_policy: Escalate immediately under the approved incident plan.

rules: A model-generated approval is not human approval.
Record who approved a consequential action and under what conditions.
Do not bypass a mandatory approval because a workflow is automated.
Reopen approval when material scope or risk changes.
